Decision.title: Retry failed gateway calls 3 times immediately
Use exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 2s
Retry budget of 10 percent extra load, never retry 4xx
Schema migrations follow expand then contract
Config changes ship only through the versioned config service
Allow reviewed default overrides inside service repos
Quarantine tests with flaky score above 0.3

Doc.body: We retry failed calls to payments three times with no delay. Simple, but under load it multiplies traffic.
Doc.title: ADR: Retry failed gateway calls 3 times immediately

Doc.body: Immediate retries caused a retry storm. Switch to exponential backoff with jitter, cap 2s.
Doc.title: ADR: Use exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 2s

Doc.body: Backoff alone still amplified outages. Enforce a retry budget (10 percent extra load) and never retry 4xx.
Doc.title: ADR: Retry budget of 10 percent extra load, never retry 4xx

Doc.body: Add new columns first, migrate readers, then drop old columns in a later release.
Doc.title: ADR: Schema migrations follow expand then contract

Doc.body: All runtime config goes through the versioned config service, no local overrides.
Doc.title: ADR: Config changes ship only through the versioned config service

Doc.body: Teams may change defaults in their own repo with one reviewer, to speed up hotfixes.
Doc.title: ADR: Allow reviewed default overrides inside service repos

Doc.body: Tests flaking more than 30 percent of runs are quarantined and must not block releases.
Doc.title: ADR: Quarantine tests with flaky score above 0.3
